OP-18 “神の支配”: Amazon Japan invite is open, the official release date is not

Live box prices →OP-18 Amazon invite →All set guides →

Research and data: OP Box Index · Published September 14, 2026 · Updated September 14, 2026 · Data sources & methodology

Amazon.co.jp lists the next One Piece main set as ONE PIECE Card Game Booster Pack 神の支配【OP-18】, sold as a 24-pack box through an invite-only sale (招待販売) with the invite-request button active. Bandai's Japanese and English product lists do not yet include an OP-18 page, so there is no official release date, card count or English name. This page records what is verifiable today and leaves the rest open.

Sources checked September 14, 2026: Bandai Japan product list and Bandai English product list (no OP-18 entry on either), and the Amazon.co.jp product listing linked from our Amazon Japan raffle page. A retailer listing is not treated as an official release date.

What is confirmed and what is not

Confirmed by the Amazon Japan listing: the set code OP-18, the Japanese title 神の支配, the box format of 24 packs, and that Amazon is taking invite requests. Not confirmed anywhere official: the release date, the card list, the number of card types, the English name, and the English release. Bandai normally publishes these on its product page before release; that page did not exist on September 14, 2026.

OP Box Index does not estimate a date from past gaps. For reference only, the last two Japanese main-set releases were OP-16 on May 30, 2026 and OP-17 on August 22, 2026, an 84-day gap. That is a fact about the past, not a forecast for OP-18.

How the Amazon Japan invite works for OP-18

The OP-18 box is listed under Amazon's invite-based sale: you press the invite-request button on the product page, and Amazon later emails invitations to a subset of requesters. Requesting is free and does not commit you to buy. The step-by-step guide, including what gates overseas delivery, is on the Amazon Japan raffle page, where OP-18 is listed with a direct link.

An open invite request is not proof that the product ships on a given day. Amazon opens requests ahead of Bandai's page in some cycles; the box ships only after Bandai releases the set.

What OP-17's launch showed

OP-17 The World's Strongest Warriors released in Japan on August 22, 2026 and in English on August 28, 2026, the closest to a simultaneous global release the game has had. Its sealed Japanese box has been tracked from the first completed eBay sale, and that page shows the launch-week price path with sample counts.

One launch is one data point. Print volume, distribution, reprints and the card list all differ between sets, so OP-17's price path is context, not evidence of what OP-18 will do.

Evidence required before a sealed-box valuation

A useful OP-18 valuation needs the official Japanese specification, the confirmed card list and treatments, language-matched completed sales with transaction counts, and a clear seal standard. Active listings show seller expectations and are not substituted for sales. Single-card prices do not translate into sealed-box value until pull rates and hit distribution are known.

Reprint information is reported only when Bandai, distributors, or dated market supply records support it. Absence of a reprint notice is not described as proof that no reprint will occur.

Update policy

This page is reviewed when Bandai publishes the OP-18 product page, when the card list appears, and when a valid sold-box sample forms after release. Material changes receive a new visible review date. Price, population and reprint fields follow the definitions in our methodology; unavailable values remain unavailable.

Frequently asked questions

When does OP-18 release?

Bandai had not published an OP-18 product page or release date on September 14, 2026. OP Box Index does not estimate a date; this page is updated the day the official page appears.

What is OP-18 called?

The Amazon Japan listing titles it 神の支配 (Kami no Shihai). Bandai has not published an official English name.

Can I pre-order OP-18 now?

Amazon Japan is taking invite requests for the OP-18 booster box (24 packs). Requesting an invite is free; Amazon later invites a subset of requesters to buy. See the Amazon Japan raffle page for the steps.

Is there an English OP-18 release date?

No. Bandai's English product list had no OP-18 entry on September 14, 2026.

What seal should a Japanese OP-18 box have?

Use the original uncut Bandai security tape as the primary factory-seal check. Added shrink is not a substitute.
